comment: Pretty much the worst teacher I've ever had.  Talks too low (and the accent doesn't help), talks to the board instead of the class, doesn't understand students' questions and simply repeats the answer on the board until the student gives up trying to ask, and really just doesn't seem to care about the course she's teaching at all.  DO NOT TAKE HER!

Her accent makes her incomprehensible and the final exam comes out of left field and gives everyone in the class a hard time, even the smart kids. Needless to say, the average was a legitimate 63 and she did not curve. Other than the final The class is easy but you want to commit suicide listening to her speak, don?t take it.
